manual.question: Is the status or error message understandable on its own, without seeing where it appeared?
manual.procedure: Trigger it; read/listen to the message in isolation.
manual.why: A message that only makes sense visually is not a status message for everyone.

manual.question: Does a screen reader announce anything unnecessarily repetitive at this state?
manual.procedure: Use a real screen reader (not a simulation) and listen.
manual.why: Repetition and verbosity are quality barriers automated tools cannot measure.
